column3: その頃、悪魔回廊の中・・
column4: At that time, inside the Devil's Corridor...

column3: 魔物大将軍ピサロが５０名の部下を連れてきていた。
column4: Great Monster General Pizarro had brought fifty subordinates.

column3: ピサロ様自身が危険ですという部下
column4: A subordinate says, 'Master Pizarro himself is in danger.'

column3: ここはゴールデンハニーの墓場で複数のゴールデンハニーの遺体が転がっている
column4: This is the Golden Hanny graveyard, with multiple corpses of Golden Hanny lying around.

column3: 金銀財宝の宝庫だそうだ、部下にいかせてネコババされては困るからな
column4: It's said to be a treasure trove of gold, silver, and valuables. I can't have any of the subordinates stealing them.

column3: 貴重な財宝は全て私のものだ。
column4: All the precious treasure is mine.

column3: しかし、よりによって・・上級悪魔ネプラカスの回遊日なんてこれは
column4: However, of all days... it's the day the high-level demon Neplacus patrols.

column3: 人間共の罠ですよ、我々と悪魔をぶつけようとする
column4: It's a human trap, trying to pit us against the demons.

column3: しかし、ピサロは金銀の事で頭いっぱい
column4: Yet Pizarro is only focused on gold and silver.
